column7: Neo-brutalist aluminum enclosure; Master, Texture, Gain and Weight sliders; Texture introduces analog octave-up content; Weight controls input high-pass character; relay bypass and protected 9V power. Manufacturer archive records V1 as initial release and says production ended in spring 2025.
column10: Treat as its own collaboration lineage with Obstructures. Later Glaive is a reworking, not the same generation.

column7: Two independent all-analog sections inspired by Big Muff and RAT; R side ranges from overdrive to distortion with Filter; M side uses Tone plus Voice; Link EQ combines the EQ controls across both sections.
column10: Dual-circuit topology and Link EQ control are strong external/function identifiers.

column7: Fuzz plus analog multi-octave generator with -2, -1, +1 and +2 octave sources; high/low octave switches, OCT MIX, TRACK and SLOW/FAST, NORMAL/WIGGLE tracking modes, separate OCT footswitch and fuzz MIX control. Current manual documents 9-18V operation and relay true bypass.
column10: Large control/footswitch architecture makes this highly identifiable; preserve manual revision separately from product generation.

column7: GPX documents a 2023 3K version with Gain, Bite and Filter controls and a turret-board presentation, following an earlier two-knob Fresh Fuzz.
column10: Treat 3K as a production/edition variant until primary evidence establishes a formal generation boundary.
